title: THANK YOU FOR JOINING BTM 2026!
body: Thank you all for making the 12th Brain Tumor Meeting such an inspiring two days. We wish you a safe journey home! Please take a minute to tell us what you liked and what we can do better next time — your feedback is anonymous.

title: Wednesday evening at Stadtgut Buch
body: Flash-orals begin at 19:15, followed by the social dinner from 20:15 until 23:00.

title: Programme subject to change
body: The app reflects the programme currently published for BTM 2026. Organiser notices will appear here if timings or rooms change.

title: Abstract book available
body: All abstracts are searchable in the app and available offline after the first complete load.
